title: Enterprise DevOps: GitOps, Change-Aware CI/CD & K8s Incident Post-Mortem Lab

steps.title: Create Local Dev Makefile Entrypoint
steps.description: Construct a root `Makefile` implementing zero-K8s local developer workflows with targets: `dev` (runs `docker compose up -d`), `dev-down` (`docker compose down`), and `dev-logs` (`docker compose logs -f`).

verification.command: test -f /home/student/enterprise-devops/Makefile && grep -q 'dev:' /home/student/enterprise-devops/Makefile && grep -q 'dev-down:' /home/student/enterprise-devops/Makefile && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Gitignored Secret Template & Environment Contract
steps.description: Establish a secure secret contract by creating a template `secrets.template.yaml` and enforcing `.gitignore` rules against committing plain-text secrets.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/enterprise-devops/secrets.template.yaml && grep -q 'secrets.yaml' /home/student/enterprise-devops/.gitignore && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Fix NetworkPolicy Cross-Namespace Label Mismatch
steps.description: Fix an incident where Pods are stuck at `Init:1/2` due to an incorrect namespaceSelector label (`name: backend` instead of `kubernetes.io/metadata.name: backend`).

verification.command: test -f /home/student/enterprise-devops/network-policy.yaml && grep -q 'kubernetes.io/metadata.name: backend' /home/student/enterprise-devops/network-policy.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL
